title: Honda CB125F
text:
Honda CB125F
There seems to be a push right now for less. This is probably driven by us seeking a correction against most new products which are flooded with too many features. Features we don’t want and didn’t ask for. Fridges with screens, , and, of course, AI integrations fucking everywhere. We know the feeling well now, enshitification, and the cramming of features into products that solve problems we never had.
So now we gawk at Kei trucks in their simplistic glory. This is where the CB125F comes in as well. A basic and reliable motorbike that can get you to work for pennies worth of fuel.
